# Migration-war CB (CK3's hungarian_migration_cb, ported): the war is
# fought over the basin, but no land changes hands in the deal itself -
# the wargoal carries humiliate's peace table (gold and humiliate only),
# and the settlement event allocates everything afterwards.
# Magyars only, and only until the settlement (which also ends the MGY tag):
# the preset 867 war bypasses prerequisites, this is for a renewed attempt.
cb_magyar_migration = {
	prerequisites = {
		tag = MGY
		NOT = { has_country_flag = kar_magyar_settled }
	}

	war_goal = humiliate
}
